relations.physicalTreatment: capacity_calendars XOR transport_asset_id/capacity_pool_id; unique per source

relations.physicalTreatment: vehicle_assignments.transport_asset_id -> transport_assets.id; ROAD; nonoverlapping active windows

relations.label: contiene
relations.physicalTreatment: route_legs.route_plan_id -> route_plans.id; unique sequence; at least one on publication

relations.label: requiere
relations.physicalTreatment: plan_resources.plan_candidate_id -> transport_plan_candidates.id; nonempty validated at publication

relations.physicalTreatment: derived DISTINCT carrier_service_id from plan_leg_assignments; no duplicate editable relation

relations.label: tramo sobre corredor
relations.physicalTreatment: route_legs.corridor_id -> route_corridors.id; nullable; preserve corridor version snapshot

relations.label: se distribuye en
relations.physicalTreatment: load_allocations(request_id,cargo_unit_index) validated against immutable request cargo snapshot

relations.label: transporta
relations.physicalTreatment: load_allocations.plan_resource_id -> plan_resources.id; same request; totals bounded; indivisible not split

relations.label: miembros autorizados
relations.physicalTreatment: organization_members.organization_id -> organizations.id; active membership checked at command time

relations.label: vincula cuenta
relations.physicalTreatment: mcp_account_links.organization_member_id -> organization_members.id; existing HAC-11 actor checks retained

relations.label: métricas con muestra
relations.physicalTreatment: v2_carrier_metrics.carrier_id -> carriers.id; sample and period mandatory

relations.label: agrupa activos
relations.physicalTreatment: vehicle_combination_assets(combination_id,asset_id); nonempty; active coupling exclusion per asset

relations.label: respalda cobertura
relations.physicalTreatment: service_areas.fulfilment_partner_id -> fulfilment_partners.id; nullable; same carrier and valid agreement

relations.label: aporta cupo
relations.physicalTreatment: capacity_pools.fulfilment_partner_id -> fulfilment_partners.id; nullable; no fabricated individual vehicle

relations.label: recursos del tramo
relations.physicalTreatment: plan_resources.plan_leg_assignment_id -> plan_leg_assignments.id; same leg/plan; nonempty per assignment

relations.label: desglosa costos
relations.physicalTreatment: v2_carrier_offers.breakdown[]; nonempty; quoted cents reconcile with issuer total

relations.label: emite manualmente
relations.physicalTreatment: v2_carrier_offers.issuer_operator_id -> carrier_operators.id; nullable for verified API/MCP issuer

relations.label: pertenece a
relations.physicalTreatment: carrier_operators.carrier_id -> carriers.id; actual auth user and carrier permission required

relations.label: capacidades de carga
relations.physicalTreatment: transport_assets.cargo_capability_definition_id -> cargo_capability_definitions.id; legacy per-asset capabilities retained for migration compatibility

relations.label: red sintética versionada

relations.label: inyecta eventos
relations.physicalTreatment: scenario file owns synthetic condition fixtures; never substitutes live condition evidence

relations.label: evalúa red
relations.physicalTreatment: RoutePlanner reads versioned corridor graph; dependency, not ownership

relations.label: oferta elegida
relations.physicalTreatment: selection_decision_offers(decision_id,offer_id); approved recovery change single offer to 1..*; exact assignment coverage

relations.label: ocupa capacidad en ventana
relations.physicalTreatment: capacity_reservations.plan_resource_id -> plan_resources.id; nullable for pre-plan hold; coherent source

relations.label: cubre servicio
relations.physicalTreatment: v2_offer_services(offer_id,service_id); nonempty; equals DISTINCT services of covered assignments

relations.label: compromete capacidad
relations.physicalTreatment: capacity_reservations.v2_booking_id -> v2_bookings.id; nullable for hold; active commitment proof per carrying resource
